Grilled Stuffed Jalapenos
By: Anonymous
Published: Wednesday, December 2, 2009 - 12:53am

Ingredients




12 Jalapeno peppers
6 strips Bacon
1 small carton Spreadable cream cheese

Preparation

1 Clean jalapeno peppers, slice lengthwise in half, leaving intact at the stem, remove seeds and membranes, fill with soft cream cheese. Cut bacon in half and wrap around jalapeno, secure with a tooth pick. Grill until bacon is done. Can also broil.
